wiki.title: Maggie Nurrenbern
wiki.extract: Maggie Nurrenbern is an American politician. She is a member of the Missouri Senate from the 17th district, serving since 2025. She previously represented the 15th district in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2021 to 2025. She is a member of the Democratic Party.
